notes: B-57 (2026-10-29): Nimble Trapfinder 'At the beginning of combat on your turn, if you have a full party, creatures you control gain "Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a PLAYER, draw a card" until end of turn.' Full party (the Trapfinder is the Rogue, plus a Cleric, a Warrior and a Wizard). The Warrior attacks into a 0/9 wall and the Wizard is unblocked: only the Wizard deals combat damage to a player, so exactly ONE card is drawn. Before the fix the granted trigger's recipient filter was universal and the Warrior's damage to the wall drew a second card.
